text: Invariant is agent-agnostic, and it works with Codex as well as Claude Code. The product, its docs and its pages name roles, such as "a coding agent", not the agent that wrote them. The working rules live in `AGENTS.md`, which any agent reads, and `CLAUDE.md` imports it. Log entries an agent decides record `agent` as who. The factory's agents gain a Codex backend alongside Claude Code, as D-0028 planned.
